explanation_full: The model comparison table shows that KNN achieved the highest R² score (0.81717) and the lowest RMSE (0.11318), indicating superior performance compared to other models. Specifically, KNN's R² is notably higher than DT (0.56045) and RF (0.77560). Furthermore, KNN also exhibits the lowest Mean Squared Error (MSE) at 0.012810, which is lower than XGBoost (0.017553) and SVM (0.018748). Overall, KNN demonstrates the strongest performance across key metrics.
